paragraphs: LONG DBA Justice Systems is a design-build integrator of unified electronic security systems, specializing in government and public safety facilities. The services offered are design-build integration, competitive-bid integration, and follow-on maintenance, applied to new construction, upgrades, and retrofits. Retrofit and upgrade work covers general government buildings, courts, jails, juvenile facilities, secure mental health facilities, and prisons.

Integration is built on PLCs, described as enabling single-point responsibility for high-security buildings. The unified package covers door and elevator controls, video surveillance, intercommunications, paging, utility controls, and alarm monitoring. Justice Systems serves as engineer-of-record on a large percentage of its projects and holds professional engineering registration in multiple states.

Reported volume is 120 projects and $50 million in total systems value, counting only the contract value of projects performed. Follow-on service and support has covered approximately 70% of the facilities built or upgraded, some $7 million in maintenance services. Procurement can run through NASPO, where LONG is an authorized dealer in Washington, Colorado, and Alaska.

quote.text: We design, implement, and service integrated security systems that accelerate your project schedule, streamline your operations, and strengthen the safety of your building and the people inside.
